params.notes:
* The in-game tooltip for ''Spell Thief'' while '''Zoe''' has a ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}'' uses the tooltip of the mimicked spell or item active.
* '''Zoe''' will cast ''Spell Thief'' in place of her own summoner spells if she has either of them as a collected ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}'', even if she tries to cast the summoner spell while it is on cooldown.
* Minions that can drop ''{{as|Spell Shards|armor}}'' are marked with a tied cosmic balloon that floats above them.
* '''Zoe''' utilizes an attack-like animation whenever one of the bubbles hurls itself at an enemy, making it look as if she can attack while moving.
* Minions holding a ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}'' will drop their shard if killed by '''Zoe''' regardless of her distance to them at the time of their death.
* Minions holding a ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}'' can drop one of the following summoner spells or item actives:
** '''Applicable summoner spells:''' {{si|Barrier}}, {{si|Cleanse}}, {{si|Exhaust}}, {{si|Ghost}}, {{si|Heal}}, {{si|Ignite}}, and {{si|Unleashed Smite}}.
*** All other summoner spells are not applicable for minions to drop, which includes {{si|Clarity}}, {{si|Hexflash}}, {{si|Mark}} / {{si|Dash}}, {{si|Smite}}, {{si|Teleport}} / {{si|Unleashed Teleport}}, and {{si|Primal Smite}}.
** '''Applicable item actives:''' {{ii|Hextech Rocketbelt}}, {{ii|Locket of the Iron Solari}}, {{ii|Profane Hydra}}, {{ii|Randuin's Omen}}, {{ii|Ravenous Hydra}}, {{ii|Shurelya's Battlesong}}, {{ii|Stridebreaker}}, {{ii|Titanic Hydra}}, and {{ii|Youmuu's Ghostblade}}.
* All summoner spells except {{si|Dash}} and {{si|Hexflash}} are applicable to drop as a ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}'' when an enemy champion uses them.
* Casting {{si|Teleport}} / {{si|Unleashed Teleport}} acquired through ''Spell Thief'' causes the Top Lane [[Role Quest]] {{si|Unleashed Teleport}} to go on {{sti|cooldown}}.{{bug}}
* The recast duration of a mimicked {{si|Mark}} cast lasts longer than the mark duration.{{bug}}
** This allows her to cast {{si|Dash}} while the mark is expired, though the spell will fail to trigger its effects with an attempted cast. ''Spell Thief's'' passive effect is still triggered, however.
* ''{{as|Spell Shards|armor}}'' may be collected while '''Zoe''' can cast {{si|Dash}} from a mimicked {{si|Mark}} cast. The new shard will replace the ability slot once {{si|Dash}} is used or expires.
* Prior to an unknown patch, the maximum distance from Zoe for enemy champions to drop a ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}'' was 2200.{{bug|2}}
* The following table lists item actives that can drop as a ''{{as|Spell Shard|armor}}'', as well as those that explicitly do not or are not applicable to drop, when an enemy champion activates them:
** [[Consumable item|Consumable]] and [[trinket]] items are excluded automatically.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Zoe}} kicks a bubble in the target direction that bursts upon the first enemy hit. At max range, it will linger as a trap for a few seconds that bursts upon enemy contact.
params.blurb2: The burst deals {{as|magic damage}} and briefly inflicts {{tip|drowsy}}, which gradually {{tip|slows}} them. Afterwards, the target falls {{tip|sleep|asleep}} for a short time, during which they cannot act.
params.blurb3: If the target is attacked during {{tip|Sleep}} by an enemy {{tip|champion}}, large {{tip|monster}}, or {{tip|turret}}, they wake up and take {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} equal to the attack, up to a cap.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zoe''' kicks a bubble in the target direction that bursts upon the first enemy hit, otherwise lingering at maximum range while slightly bouncing forward over 1 second, then becoming a trap for 5 seconds that bursts upon contact with an enemy. The bubble can move through [[terrain]] only once, but travels the entire distance as '''bonus''' range, and will fall short if it would enter terrain again.
params.description2: The burst deals {{as|magic damage}} to the target and inflicts them with {{tip|drowsy}} for {{fd|1.4}} seconds, which gradually {{tip|slows}} them until they fall {{tip|sleep|asleep}} for {{fd|2.25}} seconds. While the target is {{tip|sleep|asleep}}, they are inflicted with {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|30% magic resistance reduction}}}}.
params.description3: The next instance of non-{{tip|persistent damage|persistent}} damage from {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monsters}} or {{tip|turrets}} against the target, within {{tt|{{fd|3.25}} seconds|Fixed duration, unaffected by tenacity}} of the {{tip|sleep}} being applied, ends the sleep prematurely if it is active and deals {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} equal to the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt, capped at ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble's'' damage.
params.leveling3: {{st|Bonus Damage Cap|{{ap|70 to 230}} {{as|(+ 45% AP)}}|Maximum Mixed Damage|{{ap|140 to 460}} {{as|(+ 90% AP)}}}}
params.description4: ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble'' refunds a percentage of its {{sti|cd|cooldown}} if the bubble hits an enemy champion.
params.range: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|800|Initial missile range}} + {{tt|50|Bounce extra travel distance}}
params.width: {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|100|Initial missile width}}|{{tt|200|Lollipop diameter at end of initial missile trajectory, also edge range}}}}
params.notes:
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent falling {{tip|sleep|asleep}} nor block the wake-up damage.
** The bubble's damage and {{tip|drowsy}} application will be blocked.
* ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble's'' {{tip|sleep}} debuff is special cased to be applied to epic {{tip|monsters}} in spite of their {{tip|cc-immunity|total cc-immunity}}, without inflicting them with {{tip|sleep|sleep's}} disabling effects.
* '''Zoe''' will gain {{tip|obscured vision}} of the target while they're {{tip|sleep|asleep}} if they are not {{tip|sight|visible}}.
* If exceptionally close to terrain, the bubble will pass through without detection and will still be able to pass through a second piece of terrain - although it sacrifices any range its already used going through the first piece.
* ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble'' can interact with [[Terrain#Player-Generated|player-generated terrain]].
* At the end of the path of the initial missile, before continuing with the short bounce, ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble'' checks for targets in a {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 100 radius to immediately collide with.
** This "lollipop" is one of only a few that is larger than the ability's missile width.
* ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble'' can still be collided with during the short bounce between end of initial missile and the trap being formed.
** This seems to use a {{tip|er|icononly = true}} very small or negative collision radius, rather than normal missile collision.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
** The missile's maximum range location, or end position, is determined at the start of the cast and as such will always be fired to the same spot regardless of where '''Zoe''' is at the end of the cast time.
*** An applicable example of this can be seen in an interaction with her {{ai|Portal Jump|Zoe}}. If ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble'' is cast right before she blinks back to ''Portal Jump's'' original cast position, the range of the missile will be extended for it to fire to the same end position as if she had not blinked back. This interaction occurs in this manner due to the missile's behavior as explained prior and the fact that '''Zoe''' blinks back with ''Portal Jump'' before the cast time of ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble'' finishes, causing the cast time to finish from ''Portal Jump's'' original cast position.
{{ct|cast|items=false|consume=false|spells=true,false,false,false,false}}
<!-- Damage -->
params.damageextra:
* The '''bonus''' damage from ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble'' is dealt before '''any''' triggering damage from '''Zoe''' or her allies, and is attributed to '''Zoe''' at all times.
** If an ally expunges the {{tip|sleep}} and the bonus damage from ''Sleepy Trouble Bubble'' is enough to kill the target, '''Zoe''' will be credited the kill.
*** Additionally in this case, the allied champion will '''not''' be credited an [[assist]] at all.{{bug}}
** This will still count as damage dealt by '''Zoe''' in the damage recap.
params.tips:
* {{tip|Cleanse|Cleansing}} effects should be used on the {{tip|drowsy}} to avoid taking the bonus damage within {{fd|3.25}} seconds after falling {{tip|sleep|asleep}}.
** The timer for the bonus damage is not removed when the {{tip|sleep}} is cleansed.

blurb.plain: Active: Zoe kicks a bubble in the target direction that bursts upon the first enemy hit. At max range, it will linger as a trap for a few seconds that bursts upon enemy contact.

blurb2.plain: The burst deals magic damage and briefly inflicts drowsy, which gradually slows them. Afterwards, the target falls asleep for a short time, during which they cannot act.

description.plain: Active: Zoe kicks a bubble in the target direction that bursts upon the first enemy hit, otherwise lingering at maximum range while slightly bouncing forward over 1 second, then becoming a trap for 5 seconds that bursts upon contact with an enemy. The bubble can move through terrain only once, but travels the entire distance as bonus range, and will fall short if it would enter terrain again.

description2.plain: The burst deals magic damage to the target and inflicts them with drowsy for 1.4 seconds, which gradually slows them until they fall asleep for 2.25 seconds. While the target is asleep, they are inflicted with 30% magic resistance reduction.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Zoe}} {{tip|blinks}} in the target direction, after which she cannot move for a brief moment.
params.blurb2: Afterwards, she {{tip|blinks}} back to her starting position.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} After a {{tt|{{fd|0.15}}-second delay|From the end of the cast time, blink occurs after 0.4 seconds from the start of cast}}, '''Zoe''' {{tip|blinks}} in the target direction and remains there for {{tt|{{fd|0.95}} seconds to {{fd|1.25}} seconds|See notes}}, during which she sets her {{as|movement speed}} to a {{as|static 0|ms}} and has {{tip|unobstructed vision}}. Afterwards, she {{tip|blinks}} back to her casting position.
params.description2: ''Portal Jump {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Zoe's''' basic attack timer. '''Zoe''' {{tt|briefly|See notes}} becomes {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} after casting Portal Jump as well as after blinking back.''
params.notes:
* '''Zoe''' will remain at the blink destination for an inconsistent period of time.{{bug|1}}
* ''Portal Jump'' causes '''Zoe''' to become unable to perform any actions for a varied ~{{fd|0.55}}-{{fd|0.75}} seconds{{bug|1}} from the start of the cast time and another time for a varied ~{{fd|0.3}}-{{fd|0.5}} seconds{{bug|1}} starting from right before she blinks back.
* '''Zoe''' is able to perform any action while at the blink destination, except practically being unable to move through normal movement due to having 0 movement speed.
* ''Portal Jump's'' maximum range location, or end position, is determined at the start of the cast time and as such '''Zoe''' will always blink to the determined destination regardless of where she is at the end of the ability's cast time.
* ''Portal Jump'' will always cause '''Zoe''' to {{tip|blink}} back to her casting position regardless of where she is moved to while at the destination.
** She will still be considered to blink even if she fails to move her intended location while {{tip|attach|attached}} (e.g. if she were affected by {{ai|The Show Stopper|Sett}}).
* Upon reaching her destination, '''Zoe''' will either raspberry at the nearest enemy champion, or lick an ice cream cone when there are no enemy champions in {{tip|sight}}.
* '''Zoe's''' return position is shifted by 25 units in the target direction from her cast location.
